title: One status vocabulary on every page with the same five-way count (confirmed, reported, disputed, contradicted, unverified), and the desk's own figure beside it
note: From the review: the redesign, read for what it communicates (24 October; the news desk chief, for the editor's picks on board 138). The fact-check desk, 24 October: outside the desk's scope (it owns factcheck/** only); the status words on other pages belong to story-site and the build's helpers to dev@php.newsroom. The desk's figure for every claim is in data/factcheck.json (assessments[].display) for them to show beside the five-way count.
